candidate_sentence_map.S17: Subsequent to the period, the principal shareholder entered Luxembourg judicial reorganization proceedings with a moratorium until 24 August 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Management is focusing on efficiency, cost optimization, stronger controls and improved financial stability.
